# Deco Base

> AI-powered software to streamline underwriting, document review, and proforma workflows for real estate professionals. Get structured data from CRE documents like OMs, Loan Docs, Pro Formas, and more.

Deco Base is a platform built to neatly extract data from messy CRE documents, turning complex files into structured data you can actually use. Our AI-powered tools help real estate professionals streamline their workflows and make better decisions.

## Core Products

- [Document Extract](https://www.decobase.app/features/document-extract): Turn your documents into decisions. Our Document Extract Tool reads PSAs, loan docs, plan sets, and more - turning complex files into structured data you can actually use. Standardize everything with no more digging through PDFs. Instantly extract key deal data from Offering Memos, PSAs, investor agreements, and more.
- [Map View](https://www.decobase.app/features/map-view): Your entire deal history on a map. Our Map View connects your files to real-world locations, helping you evaluate new sites with instant context from your past deals. See your portfolio spatially with pins and layers built from your uploaded documents.
- [AI Agent](https://www.decobase.app/features/ai-agent): An AI analyst who knows real estate. Chat with an AI that reads your documents, finds what matters, and turns your data into deal-winning insights - in seconds. See deals the way GPs do with AI-powered deal insights.

## Key Features

- [Flexible Inputs](https://www.decobase.app/): Upload any CRE document - our model automatically detects its content and structure. No OCR setup needed.
- [Consistent Outputs](https://www.decobase.app/): Rent rolls, T-12s, Budgets, Schedules, Sources & Uses, and more. Verify side by side with original documents.
- [Use Anywhere](https://www.decobase.app/): Copy to clipboard or export a standardized excel file as the starting point for custom models.
- [Sync with Cloud Storage](https://www.decobase.app/features/document-extract): Integrates with Google Drive and Dropbox to ingest documents automatically.
- [Click into Your Data](https://www.decobase.app/features/map-view): Access comps, notes, and financials directly from an interactive map.
- [Citeable AI Responses](https://www.decobase.app/features/ai-agent): Every response includes traceable links to internal source documents.
- [Built for Real Estate](https://www.decobase.app/): Trained on thousands of commercial real estate documents including PSAs, loan documents, offering memos, and zoning plans.
